sections.description: SWP Painting is a modern, lightweight, and fully responsive WordPress block theme built for painting companies, house painters, painting contractors, interior and exterior painting services, wall painting and spray painting experts, decorators, renovation contractors, remodeling firms, and home improvement businesses. Its clean and professional design helps you showcase your services, completed projects, before and after galleries, customer testimonials, pricing plans, team members, and contact information with ease. Built for Full Site Editing, the theme ships with ready made block patterns for the header, hero, about, blog, banner, and footer sections, along with custom block styles, editor styles, and a flexible theme.json color and typography system. It features a mobile friendly layout, fast loading performance, clean SEO friendly code, RTL and translation ready markup, and compatibility with the latest version of WordPress. It supports the Block Editor (Gutenberg) and works seamlessly with popular page builders and plugins, allowing you to create beautiful pages without coding knowledge. Whether you're a professional painter, commercial painting contractor, wallpaper installer, drywall and plastering specialist, epoxy flooring expert, cabinet refinishing studio, waterproofing and coating company, pressure washing or power washing service, handyman, carpenter, plumber, electrician, roofing or flooring company, construction and building firm, cleaning service, landscaping business, interior design studio, architecture agency, local small business, corporate company, freelancer, or a home renovation and maintenance business, SWP Painting provides a flexible foundation for creating a professional online presence with business, services, portfolio, gallery, blog, and contact pages.
